parameter_map_selector.meaning: Exact stored paths, domain/default/mode operands and second-output rows remain in pinned TSV, not copied controls/spec tables.

prospective_unexecuted.selector: Actual paths/domain values from UltraAnalog conversion/default TSV; enumerate each non-default legal mode separately with same existing DAN028 event history. No expectation until batch review.
prospective_unexecuted.missing_join: Synthetic control setter route only; no Live mode/default/lifecycle binding.

prospective_unexecuted.input_basis: Each index once against pinned probe baseline and existing 13312change block/history; duplicate secondary/dummy indices remain controls, not public predicates. Exact legal paired/toggle values need finite batch selection before calls.
prospective_unexecuted.unresolved: Complete control perturbation vectors are not yet selected; no invented parameter semantics, waveform expectations or original run.
Finite probes can investigate local U, not general glide/unison/phase laws or host timing.

unresolved_enumeration.continuous: Unlisted continuous values, complete modulation combinations and arbitrary note/control/lifecycle histories are not enumerated by sampled vectors. P2 is index enumeration, not a complete executable input list.
unresolved_enumeration.application: No fabricated actual-instance/block/grid/arrival/reset/seed/ARM inputs; public joins remain unknown.
